title: Model Execution and Multi-Stage Feedback Payload Schema (STD-010 v1.3.0)

feedback_stage.description: Lifecycle stage of feedback: execution (runtime attempt), business_evaluation (automated domain eval), or human_review (human review/approval)

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of observed execution or evaluation event

run_id.description: Consumer workflow or benchmark run identifier

idempotency_key.description: Unique deduplication key for this feedback event

consumer.description: Calling application identifier (e.g. ai-kb, vtip-ai-sidecar, claude-code)

task.description: Business task identifier (e.g. knowledge_distillation, chat, code)

model.description: Model identifier or bare model name (backward compatible)

selected_model_id.description: Exact Hub candidate selected for execution

upstream_model_id.description: Actual model identifier verified/returned from upstream provider

resource_id.description: Infrastructure resource identifier serving the candidate

source_unit_id.description: Consumer-owned opaque unit identifier (e.g. U1, chunk-slot-42)

source_unit_hash.description: Hash of normalized source unit identity/content only (must NOT include prompt or execution parameters)

execution_spec_hash.description: Separate hash of execution specification (prompt version, params, schema, temperature)

evaluation_method.description: Evaluation methodology used for quality assessment

rubric_version.description: Version identifier of evaluation rubric/scoring criteria

evaluation_confidence.description: Consumer confidence in one specific evaluation event (separate from Hub sample confidence)

review_reason_code.description: Structured machine-readable rejection or review reason code (e.g. fact_guard_failed, structure_invalid)

candidate_rank.description: Rank of candidate in original Hub routing plan

retry_count.description: Number of retries attempted for this candidate

fallback_count.description: Number of failover switches to subsequent candidates

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by upstream provider or gateway

error_type.description: Canonical 7-class technical error category (empty on success)

error_message.description: Sanitized error message or technical diagnostic summary

quality_metrics.description: Domain-specific numeric quality metrics map (0.0 to 1.0 recommended)

ttft_ms.description: Time to first token in milliseconds

tool_call_success.description: Whether tool call execution was successful

patch_applied.description: Whether code patch was successfully applied

tests_passed.description: Whether project tests passed after coding change

lint_passed.description: Whether linter checks passed after coding change

task_completed.description: Whether overall coding task was marked completed
